info.title: CF Meet Platform — Developer Console API
info.description: The Developer Console of the CF Meet Platform: the control plane where a partner manages its workspaces, projects, environments, service accounts, API keys, scopes, webhooks, usage, limits and production access. (A workspace is called an organization in paths and fields: /v1/organizations, organizationId.) The partner's product traffic (meetings, messaging, calling) goes to the domain APIs of the same gateway, not here. Section 50 developer / enterprise control plane, served through the public API Gateway. Human console operations use the verified CF Meet session (verified by the Meeting Service through the session bridge); server automation uses scoped Platform Access credentials where noted. Organizations, projects and environments are Developer Platform metadata over canonical Platform Access tenants, applications and environments: Platform Access remains the only identity, credential and scope authority. Non-members get NOT_FOUND for another tenant's resources. Every response carries X-Request-Id. Section 53 central webhooks: the Developer Console manages an environment's webhook subscriptions, delivery and attempt history and replays under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/webhooks* and /webhook-deliveries/*. The machine-credential webhook API keeps Calling's public contract and paths (cfmeet.calling.http-api /v1/webhooks*); the API Gateway re-points it to the Developer Platform at the cut-over (cfmeet.developer-platform.internal-api documents the served routes). Section 50 service accounts: OWNER / ADMIN create, suspend and resume an environment's Platform Access service accounts under /v1/environments/{environmentId}/service-accounts* (delegated to Platform Access, the only store; DEVELOPER reads; machine credentials need `service_accounts.manage`); API credentials stay Section 54. 1.4.0 (Part VI Chapters 10–13): Section 54 credential self-service (create with the secret once, list, read, rotate with bounded overlap, revoke, suspend / resume, quota restrictions), the scope registry and project scope grants, the organization credential policy; Section 55 production-access requests (submit, read, cancel, activate) and status, environment usage (rollups, facts, CSV / JSON export, warnings) and limits; Section 57 support profiles. 1.5.0 (Part VI Chapters 14–18): activity filters (`projectId`, `action`) and cursor pagination of credentials and production-access requests. 1.7.0 (ADR 0062 / 0063, CF Meet Platform Build): the partner Users API for machine credentials (/v1/users*, delegated to Platform Access; principals.read / principals.write / user_tokens.issue; user tokens returned once), the console user list and SANDBOX test token generator, allowed websites (/v1/environments/{environmentId}/allowed-origins) and push credentials (/v1/environments/{environmentId}/push-credentials*, secrets sealed to the Notification Service, metadata only), each behind its own default-off flag; LIMIT_EXCEEDED for the optional workspace / project creation caps. 1.8.0 (ADR 0064 / 0065, CF Meet Apps): app registration on projects (/v1/projects/{projectId}/app*: immutable manifest versions, client secret shown once, review submission, grants, draft test accounts; OWNER / ADMIN; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED), the anonymous OAuth endpoints /v1/oauth/token, /revoke, /userinfo, /metadata (RFC 6749 wire format, relayed to Platform Access; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED) and the anonymous app directory /v1/app-directory* (PUBLISHED, PUBLIC apps; flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED).

tags.name: Organizations
tags.description: Workspaces (paths and fields: organizations): a partner's API customer account, backed by an EXTERNAL Platform Access tenant; ownership transfer and closure. Not CF Meet business organizations (/api/v2/organizations).

tags.name: Members
tags.description: Human members of a workspace and their roles (OWNER, ADMIN, DEVELOPER, ANALYST, BILLING).

tags.name: Invitations
tags.description: Invitations to join a workspace.

tags.name: Projects
tags.description: Projects (Platform Access applications) of a workspace.

tags.name: Environments
tags.description: Environments of a project.

tags.name: Service accounts
tags.description: Platform Access machine identities of an environment, delegated to Platform Access; never a credential.

tags.name: Credentials
tags.description: Credential metadata, issuance, rotation and revocation for service accounts.

tags.name: Scopes
tags.description: The scope registry and the scopes granted to a project.

tags.name: Production access
tags.description: Requests for production access and their review history.

tags.name: Commercial
tags.description: Commercial plans, plan assignments and billing-account references.

tags.name: Usage
tags.description: Usage facts and summaries.

tags.name: Limits
tags.description: Effective limits and limit warnings.

tags.name: Webhooks
tags.description: Developer Console webhook subscriptions, signing secret rotation, deliveries and replay.

tags.name: Activity
tags.description: Immutable activity history of a workspace.

tags.name: Support
tags.description: Support profiles and incident status.

tags.name: Partner users
tags.description: ADR 0062: partner users (Platform Access principals of an environment) and CF Meet user tokens, the device login of partner apps; the console's user list and SANDBOX token generator.

tags.name: Allowed websites
tags.description: ADR 0062: an environment's allowed websites (exact origins) for browser device logins.

tags.name: Push credentials
tags.description: ADR 0063: partner APNs / FCM push credentials, sealed to the Notification Service (metadata only here).

tags.name: Apps
tags.description: ADR 0064 / 0065: the app registered on a project (manifest versions, client secret, review submission, grants, test accounts).

tags.name: OAuth
tags.description: ADR 0064: the public OAuth 2.0 endpoints of CF Meet Apps (anonymous; RFC 6749 / 7009 / 8414 wire format).

tags.name: App directory
tags.description: ADR 0065: the public directory of PUBLISHED, PUBLIC apps (anonymous).

parameters.description: The subscription version the change is based on (stale: 409 VERSION_CONFLICT).

post.description: Issue or rotate the app's client secret (returned once; the previous secret keeps Platform Access's 24 h overlap). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

post.summary: Submit the current version for review (DRAFT / REJECTED, or an APPROVED / PUBLISHED app with pending changes; no loopback redirect; PUBLIC apps name privacy policy and terms)
post.description: Submit the current version for review (DRAFT / REJECTED, or an APPROVED / PUBLISHED app with pending changes; no loopback redirect; PUBLIC apps name privacy policy and terms). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

get.summary: List the app's installations (from Platform Access; no CF Meet account id)
get.description: List the app's installations (from Platform Access; no CF Meet account id). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

put.summary: Replace the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, at most 25, format checked only)
put.description: Replace the draft test accounts (CF Meet account ids, at most 25, format checked only). Roles: OWNER, ADMIN. Human console session only (machine credentials are refused). Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APPS_ENABLED.

post.summary: Exchange an authorization code (PKCE S256) or a refresh token for tokens
post.description: RFC 6749 token endpoint. Anonymous at the API Gateway: the client authenticates with its client secret (client_secret_basic or client_secret_post) and Platform Access verifies it; refresh tokens rotate and a reused code or superseded refresh token revokes the whole installation. Responses are snake_case with Cache-Control: no-store. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

post.summary: Revoke an access or refresh token (RFC 7009)
post.description: RFC 7009 revocation: 200 whatever the token's state, 401 invalid_client when client authentication fails. Anonymous at the API Gateway; same client authentication as the token endpoint. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read the signed-in user's profile with a user access token
get.description: Bearer cfoa_ user access token with profile:read (email only with profile:email). Anonymous at the API Gateway: Platform Access introspects the token, the Meeting Service supplies the profile; sub is pairwise per app. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read the OAuth authorization server metadata
get.description: RFC 8414-style metadata: the authorization endpoint (the CF Meet consent page), token, revocation and userinfo endpoints, scopes, PKCE S256, the code response type and both grant types. Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_OAUTH_ENABLED.

get.summary: List the published public apps
get.description: The app directory: PUBLISHED, PUBLIC, not suspended apps with their published manifest (name, description, logo, developer, scopes, privacy and terms URLs, whether they have an in-meeting surface). Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED.

get.summary: Read one published public app
get.description: One directory entry (anything not PUBLISHED, PUBLIC and live is 404). Anonymous. Flag DEVELOPER_PLATFORM_APP_DIRECTORY_ENABLED.

userSession.description: The signed-in developer's CF Meet session (Developer Console). Never a machine credential.

platformCredential.description: A Platform Access API credential (server-side only; never in a browser).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Replays return the original response; reuse with a different request is IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. One-time secrets are never replayed.

IdempotentReplayed.description: `true` when the response is the stored result of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key (no new effect).
